description_en: Queries the statistics of runtimes of a specified type under the current Alibaba Cloud account, grouped by agent platform and agent provider, including the total count, the count of runtimes without model configurations, the count of runtimes without channel configurations, the count of risky runtimes, and the count of expired runtimes
description_zh: 按Agent平台和Agent提供商分组，统计当前阿里云账号下指定类型Runtime的总数、未配置模型数、未配置通道数、存在风险数和已过期数
name: GetAgentRuntimeStatistic

parameters.help_en: The agent provider used to filter the statistics scope, such as AgenticComputer. If you do not specify this parameter, statistics for all agent providers are returned. If you specify an unsupported value, a parameter error is returned
parameters.help_zh: Agent提供商，用于筛选统计范围，如AgenticComputer。不传时统计全部Agent提供商；传入不支持的取值时返回参数错误
parameters.name: agent_provider

parameters.help_en: The business type used to filter runtimes of a specific business type
parameters.help_zh: 业务类型，用于筛选指定业务类型的Runtime
parameters.name: biz_type

parameters.help_en: The agent platform used to filter the statistics scope, such as ENTERPRISE_AGENTIC_COMPUTER. If you do not specify this parameter, statistics for all agent platforms are returned. If you specify an unsupported value, a parameter error is returned
parameters.help_zh: Agent平台，用于筛选统计范围，如ENTERPRISE_AGENTIC_COMPUTER。不传时统计全部Agent平台；传入不支持的取值时返回参数错误
parameters.name: agent_platform

Data.description_en: The list of runtime statistics grouped by agent platform and agent provider. If AgentProvider is specified but no matching runtimes are found, a record with all statistical values set to 0 is returned
Data.description_zh: 按Agent平台和Agent提供商分组的Runtime统计列表。传入AgentProvider但没有匹配的Runtime时，返回一条各统计值均为0的记录

AgentDisplayName.description_en: The agent display name, which is determined by both the agent platform and the agent provider. For example, OpenClaw under the ENTERPRISE platform is displayed as OpenClaw, and OpenClaw under the JVS platform is displayed as JVS Claw
AgentDisplayName.description_zh: Agent显示名称，由Agent平台和Agent提供商共同确定。例如ENTERPRISE平台下的OpenClaw显示为OpenClaw，JVS平台下的OpenClaw显示为JVS Claw

AgentPlatform.description_en: The agent platform, such as ENTERPRISE_AGENTIC_COMPUTER

AgentProvider.description_en: The agent provider, such as AgenticComputer

ExpiredCount.description_en: The number of expired runtime resources in the group. A runtime is counted as expired if its resource status is Expired or Ceased, case-insensitive
ExpiredCount.description_zh: 该分组下已过期的Runtime资源数。资源状态为Expired或Ceased时计入，不区分大小写
ExpiredCount.title_en: 已过期的 Runtime 资源总数（resource_info.resourceStatus 为 Expired/EXPIRED，忽略大小写）
ExpiredCount.title_zh: 已过期的 Runtime 资源总数（resource_info.resourceStatus 为 Expired/EXPIRED，忽略大小写）

NoChannelConfiguredRuntimeCount.description_en: The number of runtime resources without channel configurations in the group, which is the total number of runtime resources minus the number of runtime resources with channel configurations
NoChannelConfiguredRuntimeCount.description_zh: 该分组下未配置通道的Runtime资源数，即Runtime资源总数减去已配置通道的Runtime资源数
NoChannelConfiguredRuntimeCount.title_en: 未配置通道的 Runtime 资源总数
NoChannelConfiguredRuntimeCount.title_zh: 未配置通道的 Runtime 资源总数

NoModelConfiguredRuntimeCount.description_en: The number of runtime resources without model configurations in the group. A runtime is considered to have a model configured if a model is configured for the runtime itself or its associated resource group
NoModelConfiguredRuntimeCount.description_zh: 该分组下未配置模型的Runtime资源数。Runtime自身或其所属资源组已配置模型时，均视为已配置模型
NoModelConfiguredRuntimeCount.title_en: 未配置模型的 Runtime 资源总数
NoModelConfiguredRuntimeCount.title_zh: 未配置模型的 Runtime 资源总数

RiskyRuntimeCount.description_en: The number of risky runtime resources in the group, deduplicated by runtime ID. A runtime is counted as risky if it has any of the following risks: model configuration modified, third-party channel configuration modified, or agent being uninstalled
RiskyRuntimeCount.description_zh: 该分组下存在风险的Runtime资源数，按Runtime ID去重统计。存在模型配置被修改、三方通道配置被修改或Agent被卸载中任一风险即计入
RiskyRuntimeCount.title_en: 存在风险的 Runtime 资源总数
RiskyRuntimeCount.title_zh: 存在风险的 Runtime 资源总数

TotalRuntimeCount.description_en: The total number of runtime resources in the group, deduplicated by runtime ID
TotalRuntimeCount.description_zh: 该分组下的Runtime资源总数，按Runtime ID去重统计
TotalRuntimeCount.title_en: 总的 Runtime 资源总数
TotalRuntimeCount.title_zh: 总的 Runtime 资源总数

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which uniquely identifies the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用于标识请求的唯一 ID
RequestId.title_en: 请求ID，用于标识请求的唯一 ID
RequestId.title_zh: 请求ID，用于标识请求的唯一 ID

TotalCount.description_en: The number of returned statistics records, which is the length of the Data list
TotalCount.description_zh: 返回的统计记录条数，即Data列表的长度
